about.title: About DCC Music
about.hero: DCC Music helps songwriters turn ideas into complete songs, generate chord sheets, organise projects and share their creations professionally.
about.why1: Many people have a good song idea but do not know how to turn it into a finished song. They may need organised lyrics, production, cover art, promotion or simply an easy tool to use.
about.why2: DCC Music was created to bridge that gap. It brings AI creation, project organisation, a songwriter workspace, songs, videos and sharing tools together in one place.
about.why3: Simplicity comes first. Songwriters can write an idea, submit lyrics, record themselves singing a passage or upload a song to improve. Studio AI helps develop it into a more complete track.
about.why4: Every creation is saved in a project with its history, versions, date, lyrics, audio and cover art. Songwriters can return later, compare versions and choose which song to keep developing.
about.studioTitle: Studio AI: from idea to finished song
about.studio1: Studio AI helps songwriters at every stage: write or improve lyrics, generate songs, record vocals in the browser, use a version as inspiration, create cover art and keep everything organised.
about.studio2: The goal is to give songwriters control. You do not need technical experience: describe what you want to create and follow the project in your account.
about.studioItem1Text: Create, improve or complete lyrics with ease.
about.studioItem2Text: Sing a passage and use your recording as a reference.
about.studioItem3Text: Listen to the generated versions and choose your favourite.
about.studioItem4Text: Keep lyrics, audio, cover art and history organised.
about.chords1: After creating a song in Studio AI, you can generate a PDF chord sheet with lyrics, chords, key and BPM. It is saved in your account under My Projects, in the Chords filter.
about.chords2: This service costs 10 credits per song and is available for songs created in Studio AI.
about.chordsItem4Text: Download it again whenever you like.
about.value1Text: Technology should serve music and make life easier for songwriters.
about.value2Text: The platform is designed so anyone can create with ease.
about.value3Text: Every song should be saved, easy to find and ready to develop further.
about.historyText: Studio AI projects keep lyrics, audio, versions, cover art and dates together. This helps songwriters follow each song’s progress.
about.promotionText: Songwriters can create privately, choose their favourite version and then share or publish their music with a professional presentation.
about.helpText: Contact support. If your question is about a Studio AI song, include the project code so we can help you faster.

questions.question: What is DCC Music?
questions.answer: DCC Music is a platform where you can listen to songs and watch videos, discover songwriters, and create music with artificial intelligence. Signed-in songwriters also have access to AI Studio, Song Chords, and promotion tools.

questions.question: Do I need to pay to use the website?
questions.answer: No. Listening to songs and watching videos is free and does not require an account. To comment, rate content, or create with AI Studio, use a songwriter account.

questions.question: Can I listen to songs and watch videos on my phone?
questions.answer: Yes. The website works on phones, tablets, and computers. For the best experience, use an up-to-date browser such as Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox.

questions.question: How do I sign up as a songwriter?
questions.answer: Open the songwriter sign-up page, enter your information, and create your account. You can then manage songs, videos, AI Studio projects, credits, and your account statement.

questions.question: What can I do in the songwriter area?
questions.answer: You can create songs with AI Studio, generate song chords, publish songs and videos, manage projects, buy credits, comment, rate content, and use the features included in your plan.

questions.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
questions.answer: On the songwriter login page, select the password recovery option and follow the instructions. Contact support if you still cannot access your account.

questions.question: Where can I see my credit balance and statement?
questions.answer: After signing in, select your name at the top of the website and open Account & Statement. It shows your balance, transactions, and usage history.

questions.question: What is AI Studio?
questions.answer: AI Studio is the DCC Music tool for creating songs with artificial intelligence. Enter a title, style, mood, and idea, and the platform helps create lyrics, arrangement, audio, and cover art.

questions.question: Can AI create the lyrics too?
questions.answer: Yes. You can generate lyrics from scratch, improve existing lyrics, or complete an idea you have already started.

questions.question: Can I upload a finished song to improve it?
questions.answer: Yes. Use Improve Song to upload an audio reference and create a new production.

questions.question: Can I record my voice directly on the website?
questions.answer: Yes. You can record in your browser, sing a short section or idea, review the transcription, and use the recording as a reference.

questions.question: Can I use my own cloned voices?
questions.answer: Yes. When available for your account, you can add and verify voices for use in AI Studio creations.

questions.question: What is the maximum song length?
questions.answer: AI Studio is designed to create songs up to 4 minutes and 30 seconds long. This helps prevent excessively long or repetitive audio.

questions.question: Can I choose between the two generated versions?
questions.answer: Yes. When a project has multiple versions, you can listen to each one and choose the version you want to use or turn into song chords.

questions.question: What are Song Chords on DCC Music?
questions.answer: This service organizes the lyrics and chords of your AI Studio song into a clean chord sheet that is ready to play or print.

questions.question: How much does it cost to generate song chords?
questions.answer: A successful generation costs 10 DCC credits.

questions.question: What do I receive?
questions.answer: You receive a PDF chord sheet and can also view the lyrics and chords on screen, including the key and BPM when available.

questions.question: Can I use a song created in AI Studio?
questions.answer: Yes. Select the version you want on the Song Chords page. The platform may automatically select a version when you arrive from a recent project.

questions.question: Can I upload my own audio?
questions.answer: During this initial phase, Song Chords is available for songs created in AI Studio.

questions.question: Where are my chord sheets saved?
questions.answer: Completed chord sheets remain saved in your account so you can download them again.

questions.question: Will I pay again if I generate the same song?
questions.answer: No. If the chord sheet was completed before, the saved result is reused without deducting credits again.

questions.question: How do AI Studio credits work?
questions.answer: Each AI Studio song uses credits. A new Song Chords generation uses 10 credits. Credits may come from your plan, one-time purchases, or current promotions.

questions.question: Can I buy credits without a monthly plan?
questions.answer: Yes. You can buy song credits to create songs and chord sheets without relying on a monthly plan. Larger purchases may have a lower per-song price.

questions.question: Where can I see what used my credits?
questions.answer: Open Account & Statement from the menu under your name. It lists AI Studio creations, chord sheets, credit purchases, and other transactions.

questions.question: Are purchased credits added immediately?
questions.answer: Credits are normally added automatically after payment confirmation. If your payment was approved but the credits are missing, contact support with your account email.

questions.question: Where are my AI-created songs?
questions.answer: Your songs are stored under My Projects in AI Studio. Each project may include lyrics, cover art, generated versions, and creation history.

questions.question: Can I share a song or video?
questions.answer: Yes. Public song and video pages can be shared by link. You can also publish an AI Studio song on DCC Music and use its public link or embedded player.

questions.question: How do I find music by style?
questions.answer: Use the filters on the public song and video pages to search by genre, songwriter, or content.

questions.question: How do I request help with a specific project?
questions.answer: Open the project in AI Studio, copy its project code, and include that code when contacting support.

questions.question: How do I report a website problem?
questions.answer: Email suporte@dccmusic.online. If possible, include your account email, project code, and a short description of what happened.

faq.answer: Yes. Describe your song idea or use your own lyrics as a starting point.

faq.question: Can I try it before buying?
faq.answer: Yes. After signing up, you can try your first creation for free.
